description: Supervised TLVMC patients who never appear in a validation partition across the 10 repeats of the subject-disjoint protocol. Derived from the released split manifests: the 100-patient supervised pool is the union of train_subjects and test_subjects over the defog-family manifests (_primary_v32/) and the tdcsfog-family manifests (_ablation_v39_route/, same splits); the scored union is the union of test_subjects. With ten independent 70/30 draws, a given patient stays on the development side in every repeat with probability (70/100)^10 = 0.028, so about 3 of 100 are expected to be never held out; the observed count matches.
